name: Steven Shearrill
headline: Veteran-focused Real Estate Broker (LPT Realty) and VA Loan Officer (Patriot Pacific Financial) serving Temecula Valley and San Diego County. Retired U.S. Navy Chief.
shortHeadline: Veteran Realtor & VA Loan Officer · Temecula & San Diego
summary: Steven Shearrill is a retired U.S. Navy Chief, a California Real Estate Broker with LPT Realty (DRE #01988316) and a VA Mortgage Loan Originator with Patriot Pacific Financial Corp (NMLS #2449246). He serves military families, veterans and first-time buyers in Temecula Valley and San Diego County, California, and is one of the few professionals in the area licensed to handle both the home purchase and the VA loan.
